title: FlavorsofDawn
tagline: New art viewing each morning with direct purchase from the creators
description:
Flavors of Dawn is a project where new images from different projects are highlighted in your browser when you first start up your browser. Youll be able to purchase the image and tip the creator. 
The project will have a staking program where you can stake your coins to help curate the images on the site.
how_its_made:
### Current state

Currently we have a wordpress site up and running. We are working on a custom post type, and an ethereum wallet integration. 

### Roadmap

The roadmap is to get the custom post type up and running, and to integrate an ethereum wallet. We are working with different creators to get their images on our site. 

### Contributing

We are looking for contributors to help us with design, development, and marketing.
